name: aqa-pulse
description: Изолированный дашборд AQA Pulse для аналитики прогонов Playwright

scripts.api:demo: npm run generate:history-demo && npm run api
scripts.generate: npm run parse -- ./fixtures/sample-llm-report.json ./dist/dashboard-data.json && npm run build -- ./dist/dashboard-data.json ./dist/index.html
scripts.generate:history-demo: npm run parse -- ./fixtures/sample-llm-report-previous.json ./dist/dashboard-data.json ./dist/history.json --branch main --commit abcdef123456 --author "QA Bot" && npm run parse -- ./fixtures/sample-llm-report.json ./dist/dashboard-data.json ./dist/history.json --branch main --commit fedcba654321 --author "QA Bot" && npm run build -- ./dist/dashboard-data.json ./dist/index.html
scripts.smoke: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['dist','history'].forEach((dir)=>{ if(fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.rmSync(dir,{recursive:true,force:true}); });" && npm run generate:history-demo && npm run typecheck
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Пакет aqa-pulse является внутренним и не предназначен для публикации. Публикуй только aqa-pulse-client.'); process.exit(1)"
